🔒 Privacy

The Beholder's Gazette is a static website. There are no accounts, no logins, no ads, and no tracking cookies. This page explains the little data that is involved. Last updated October 10, 2026.

🦅 Subscribe and Contact forms

If you subscribe by raven or send us a message, the details you type (your email address, plus your name and message if you give them) are sent to Formspree, a form service that delivers them to the editor's inbox. We use them only to send you the Gazette or to reply to you. We never sell or share them.

To unsubscribe, or to have your details deleted, send a message through the contact form.

🎒 Saved in your own browser

Some tools remember things using your browser's local storage. This data stays on your device. It is never sent to us, and clearing your browser's site data removes it.

  • Vault of Wonders (loot generator): the treasure you save.
  • Town Square (NPC generator): your saved NPCs.
  • The Tavern (rumors): rumors you drew recently, so you don't get repeats.
  • Spellbook: your named spell lists and the spells you starred in each. A shared list link carries only the list name and spell names.
  • Merchant's Row (shop generator): the shop currently on the page, including any haggle roll.
  • DM Session Kit: the town crier's headline, rumor, NPC, loot, and shop currently on the page, so a refresh doesn't lose them.
  • Offline copies: the site saves the tools, their data, its fonts, and the pages you read in your browser's cache, so the tools work with no connection. This is ordinary site data: nothing about you is in it, and clearing site data removes it.

🌐 Other services

Like most websites, pages load fonts from Google Fonts and some background images from Unsplash. Those services see your IP address when your browser fetches the files. The site itself is hosted on GitHub Pages, which keeps standard server logs. Links to Patreon take you to Patreon's site, which has its own privacy policy.

The Gazette does not currently use analytics. If that changes, this page will say so first.

📰 Satire notice

The Gazette is satire. Articles are parody inspired by real events and are not real news. All names in articles are fictional stand-ins.
